verdict.rationale: Weave's own marketing describes an event-to-action pipeline: built-in and custom signals classify agent interactions, and alerts send Slack notifications and trigger webhook automations. Users can also define custom signals that tag agent turns for behaviors they specify. However, this rests only on marketing-site statements plus a release-note title, with no documentation of how rules, conditions, triggers or actions are configured. missing for 10: documented rule/condition configuration for alerts, documented webhook automation setup and payloads, range of supported event types and actions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
